data.narrative:
HIMERA is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Misha Rudominsky and Oleksiy Oliynyk, having raised $2.5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods apply to this assessment. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $2M raised proxy as a base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $6M valuation. Peer-Median methodology examines 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A). The peer median of $400M anchors the upper analysis, with the range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $460M, with a median of $203M. The substantial spread reflects the structural tension between stage-appropriate metrics ($6M) and peer multiples in a high-growth defense tech sector where comparable companies command substantially higher valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue traction (not provided), relative product maturity versus named competitors, and whether HIMERA's profile aligns more closely with early-stage or established peers. Additional diligence on unit economics and customer acquisition would sharpen the range.
